HOW THIS SITS WITH ROOFR
Roofr stays the CRM, the source of measurement reports, and where the contract is signed. Igloo Hub owns the pricing conversation — it works out the number and presents the five options — then the accepted package goes into Roofr as the proposal the customer signs. Every record above carries both numbers so the two sides tie together. Roofr has no public API, so that handoff is manual today; the Zapier hook can at least create the Job and Customer automatically.
